title: uu_env incorrectly rejects backslashes within single-quoted strings accepted by GNU env (CVE-2026-35377)
description: The uu_env utility incorrectly rejects certain backslash sequences within single-quoted strings in its -S/--split-string parsing, diverging from GNU env behavior. Specifically, uu_env treats sequences like '\x' as invalid, whereas GNU env keeps backslashes literal except for specific escapes. This issue affects uu_env versions prior to 0.10.0 and has been fixed in version 0.10.0. The vulnerability has a low severity rating and does not impact confidentiality or integrity but may cause availability issues due to errors.
